blurb: Above the Poconos Skydivers is the oldest continuously running USPA member skydiving center in the world, located in Hazle Township, PA. They offer tandem skydiving for first-timers and solo skydiving at 10,000 ft for experienced jumpers. The center also provides FAA parachute rigging services and skydiving lessons with video options.
